description: This file defines utility classes and macros for handling results and stack trace errors, including formatting and error propagation mechanisms, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes class definitions for StackTraceEntry and StackTraceError, as well as macros for error handling.

classes.name: StackTraceEntry
classes.description: Represents a single entry in a stack trace, including file, line, function, and message details, with formatting capabilities.

classes.name: StackTraceError
classes.description: Encapsulates a collection of stack trace entries, providing methods for message formatting, error handling, and integration with expected types.

methods.name: operator StackTraceError() &&
methods.description: Converts a StackTraceEntry into a StackTraceError by pushing itself into the error's stack.

methods.name: operator android::base::expected<T, StackTraceError>() &&
methods.description: Converts a StackTraceEntry into an expected type with a StackTraceError.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses format specifiers for custom formatting of StackTraceEntry.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a StackTraceEntry according to specified format specifiers.

methods.name: PushEntry
methods.description: Adds a StackTraceEntry to the StackTraceError's internal stack.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the error message.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the stack trace.

methods.name: FormatForEnv
methods.description: Formats the error for environment display, optionally with color.
